app.name: DClaw Offboard
app.description: AI-powered offboarding platform that automates compliance, protects company assets, and preserves institutional knowledge — all while treating departing employees with dignity.

hero.headline: Offboarding That Protects Your Business
hero.subheadline: Automate compliance, recover assets, revoke access, and capture critical knowledge with AI-powered workflows.

features.title: AI Offboard Copilot
features.description: An intelligent assistant that guides managers through compliant, compassionate offboarding. Get instant answers about final pay, benefits, references, and compliance — personalized to each employee's role and tenure.

features.title: Smart Offboarding Checklists
features.description: Auto-generated checklists tailored to department and role. Track IT, HR, finance, and manager tasks with dependencies, deadlines, and real-time progress tracking.

features.title: Asset Recovery & Inventory
features.description: Track every company asset — laptops, phones, keys, badges. Auto-generate recovery lists, record conditions, and generate shipping labels for remote employees.

features.title: Access Revocation Automation
features.description: One-click revocation across 20+ systems. Revoke email, Slack, GitHub, VPN, and building access with full audit trails. Know exactly who revoked what and when.

features.title: AI Exit Interview Analysis
features.description: Schedule and conduct exit interviews with AI transcription and sentiment analysis. Extract themes, identify trends, and generate actionable insights for leadership.

features.title: Knowledge Transfer & Handover
features.description: Structured templates for capturing project docs, contacts, passwords, and process documentation. AI-powered knowledge extraction identifies gaps before they become problems.

features.title: Alumni Network & Rehire Tracking
features.description: Maintain positive relationships with former employees. Track rehire eligibility, send anniversary check-ins, and build a talent pipeline for boomerang hires.

features.title: Final Pay & Compliance Calculator
features.description: Accurate to the penny. Calculate final pay, unused PTO payout, severance, and deductions. Generate compliance reports with state-law validation.

steps.title: Create Checklist
steps.description: Enter employee details and we auto-generate a role-specific offboarding checklist with IT, HR, finance, and manager tasks.

steps.title: Execute & Track
steps.description: Assign tasks, track progress in real-time, and let the AI Copilot guide you through every compliance requirement.

steps.title: Revoke & Recover
steps.description: One-click revocation of all system access. Track asset returns with condition assessment and shipping labels.

steps.title: Learn & Improve
steps.description: AI-analyzed exit interviews reveal retention insights. Alumni network keeps your talent pipeline warm.

testimonials.quote: DClaw Offboard cut our offboarding time by 60% and eliminated the compliance anxiety. The audit trail alone is worth it.
testimonials.author: Sarah Chen

testimonials.quote: The AI Copilot guided us through a complex offboarding with multi-state compliance requirements. Would have taken weeks without it.
testimonials.author: Marcus Rivera
